prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished wide editorial concept illustration for a Korean weekly game-development report: a small tabletop cardboard prototype of a rain-soaked delivery game, a single screen with a fork between two clearly different routes, puddle risk on the shorter path, a destination and a simple observation checklist. Soft blue-gray and warm paper colors, clear visual hierarchy, professional calm 3D paper-craft look. This is a conceptual example, not an actual game screenshot. No text, logos, UI chrome or watermark. Korean explanatory text will be supplied separately in accessible HTML.
limitation: Concept illustration, not a screenshot or result of a playable prototype. Time is recorded immediately after generation, not a service-provided timestamp.
reviewScope: 생성된 그림, 대체 텍스트·요약, 실제 프롬프트와 파일 해시를 대조했어요.
reviewLimitation: 생성 시각은 서비스가 제공한 시각이 아니라 생성 직후 관측한 시각이에요.

reviewEvidence.scope: 출처·실제 파일과 표시 범위의 독립 검수 기록; 원장 수정 후 상태 문구는 별도 대조
